changelog.summary: Turns SEO Intelligence into a chat-led two-Crew proposal with a technical issue to buyer-question handoff, pending setup checks, and executable fictional contracts.

title: SEO Intelligence
description: Coordinate a technical SEO analyst and buyer-question mapper to find source-backed search opportunities on an approved site, with review before any page change.
setup_prompt: Treat SEO Intelligence as a proposal. Inspect my site, existing Crews, approved crawl scope, buyer and market first. Reuse or propose distinct SEO Analyst and Search Opportunity Mapper Crews, show their source access and exact artifact handoff, then ask for my review of the concrete plan. Builder sets up and manually tests the route in chat; selection alone creates no Crew, publication, schedule or site change.

setup_inputs.label: Canonical website and approved crawl/page scope
Offer, target buyer, market and primary useful visitor action
Authorized site or crawl records and dated buyer-question evidence
Search Console property/export or baseline-first decision
Page change owner, review policy and technical retest rule
Manual-only or reviewed monitoring cadence and timezone

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create an approved SEO or search Crew with an idempotency key and Workflow-bound Crew step

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Read the validated SEO issue artifact through a checked Workflow alias

recommended_tools.name: Google Search Console MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized queries, impressions, clicks, and page performance behind a finding

recommended_tools.name: Site-crawl CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Crawl authorized scope for indexation, links, redirects, metadata, and page experience signals

recommended_tools.name: Rank-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read authorized keyword rankings across locales and devices for tracked universes

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Persist rank snapshots, crawl findings, gaps, briefs, and follow-up outcomes

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether SEO insight explains organic acquisition outcomes
Actionability, measurement cost, and decision value
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Reviewed SEO Crew roster and access map
Validated technical SEO issue list and linked buyer-question opportunity map
Manual two-Crew run with blocked and reviewed next actions
Paused monitoring proposal with baseline or comparable search evidence
